en.title: Press kit
en.intro: Music, live footage and ready-to-use material for promoters, festival teams and media.
en.bio: Sky Hook is an alternative rock band from Niš, Serbia, formed in 2023. The band's sound brings together melodic guitar lines, post-punk tension, surf rhythms and heavier textures. Their debut album Gde ptice lete, released in April 2025 through Pop Depresija / Zeleni Kačket, features 13 songs. Live appearances include Nišville, Čupin Rock Memorijal and club shows in Niš, Belgrade and Skopje.

sr.title: Press kit
sr.intro: Muzika, live snimak i materijali spremni za organizatore koncerata, festivale i medije.
sr.bio: Sky Hook je alternativni rok bend iz Niša, osnovan 2023. godine. Zvuk benda spaja melodične gitarske linije, post-punk nerv, surf ritmove i teže teksture. Debitantski album Gde ptice lete, objavljen u aprilu 2025. za Pop Depresiju / Zeleni Kačket, sadrži 13 pesama. Bend je nastupao na Nišville festivalu, Čupinom Rock Memorijalu i u klubovima u Nišu, Beogradu i Skoplju.
